holes_found.description: TLDR factual error: tldr_evidence begins "The dome cites Hebrew words from Job and Genesis to claim the firmament is made of cast copper or bronze." The dome cites Job 37:18 and **Deuteronomy 28:23** (raw-text/02-wins.txt:119 — "WIN-034 — Firmament Material = Cast Copper/Bronze CONFIRMED (Job 37:18, Deut 28:23)"; raw-text/05-model.txt:79-80; and our own detail_evidence which correctly says "Both cited verses use figurative language — Job 37:18 ... Deuteronomy 28:23"). Genesis is not cited by the dome for WIN-034. Per the curmudgeon TLDR rubric, TLDR factual errors are MAJOR severity because readers see TLDRs first and may not expand. A dome defender pasting this sentence into a rebuttal can immediately discredit our review ("they can’t even name the right Bible book — confuses Genesis with Deuteronomy"). The error is also internally inconsistent: the same tldr_evidence then quotes Job 37:18 by chapter:verse but never quotes any Genesis passage, so the wrongness is visible inside the TLDR itself even without checking the dome source.
holes_found.recommendation: Single-word patch: tldr_evidence "Job and Genesis" → "Job and Deuteronomy". No other change needed; the rest of the TLDR remains accurate. Decider can self-apply trivially.

But detail_evidence body only substantively narrates two of the three: the radio-astronomy paragraph (with skin depth ~2 μm at 1 GHz) and the Schumann paragraph (with 8.78 Hz contradiction). The CMB-160-GHz-skin-depth-0.16-μm contradiction with WIN-048 — which is the third independent leg — is mentioned only in passing ("radio telescopes (VLA, ALMA, FAST) routinely observe pulsars, quasars, and the CMB through this zone") without the dedicated 160 GHz skin-depth math that makes it a separate testable instance. A reader expanding the detail block to verify the 3-claim accusation finds only 2 of the 3 substantively defended. A defender can argue: "your finding-row promises three; your detail only explains two; the third is rhetorical inflation." The argument is correct (the CMB-160-GHz leg lives in finding+tldr+verdict_text), but the detail-page expansion under-promises against the summary-row promise.

stronger_arguments.description: The Self-Contradicted verdict survives even if a defender attacks the Schumann leg specifically. The two EM-opacity legs (radio astronomy at 1 GHz; CMB at 160 GHz) are independent of any Schumann formula-switch debate — they depend only on copper’s bulk conductivity and the observation that radio telescopes and CMB observatories see through the alleged firmament. Pattern (2) requires only one closed loop on the dome’s own commitments; we have at least two even if the Schumann instance is contested. The verdict is robust to which Schumann statistic is preferred and robust to losing the Schumann leg entirely.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome’s WIN-034 is biblically defensible as etymology: raqia ("firmament") in Job 37:18 and nechoshet ("bronze") in Deuteronomy 28:23 are real Hebrew terms used in the cited passages (raw-text/05-model.txt:79-80 quotes both directly). The dome is also correct that ancient Hebrew cosmology, read flatly, depicted the sky as a solid metallic dome — a view shared with Mesopotamian and Egyptian creation literature. As Hebrew etymology, the citation chain is not fabricated; the dome did not invent the verses.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Hebrew etymology is not cosmology. The dome moves from "the Hebrew text uses metal imagery for the sky" (literarily true) to "the firmament is therefore a physical cast-copper shell at 837–8,537 km altitude" (a physical specification with measurable consequences). Once that specification becomes load-bearing — used in WIN-029 (Schumann conductive ceiling) and assumed by WIN-048 (CMB observability through it) — the consequences become testable. Three independent tests close on it: GHz radio astronomy sees through the shell (impossible for copper); 160 GHz CMB measurement sees through the shell (even more impossible); and the dome’s own H(r) produces a Schumann fundamental of 8.78 Hz at the pole minimum, not the observed 7.83 Hz (WIN-038’s canonical pole-floor derivation). The biblical literalism is a separate, independent flag (unfalsifiability on direct material-sampling grounds) — but the load-bearing-premise pathway makes the SC verdict primary, and the SC verdict does not depend on the biblical reading being wrong; it depends on the dome’s own published numbers contradicting the dome’s own published commitment.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A capable dome defender would attack the verdict’s "three independent self-contradictions" structure head-on: "Two of your three legs (radio astronomy and 160 GHz CMB) are the same mechanism — copper opacity to high-frequency EM — instantiated at different frequencies. Per your own finding, you concede this: ‘one EM-opacity argument instantiated at two frequencies.’ So the real count is 2 mechanisms (EM-opacity + cavity-resonance), not 3. The Schumann leg invokes the quarter-wave formula f = c/(4H), which is a parallel-plate simplification that breaks down at planetary scale; the honest Schumann mode in a curved cavity is the transverse TM mode f = c√(n(n+1))/(2πR), and you have not solved that eigenmode problem in the dome’s specific geometry. Until you do, calling 7.83 Hz ‘impossible’ overreaches. That collapses the count from 2 mechanisms to 1: copper EM-opacity at GHz. One contradiction is a problem, not a pattern. And the EM-opacity argument has its own escape: the dome could be a discontinuous mesh / aperture structure that is bulk-conductive enough for Schumann coupling but transparent at the millimeter scales of GHz/160 GHz observations. Then there is no contradiction at all."

quantitative_verification.computations: Python: σ_Cu = 5.96e7 S/m, μ_0 = 4π·1e-7 H/m. δ = √(2/(ω·μ·σ)). At 1 GHz: δ = 2.062 μm. At 160 GHz: δ = 0.163 μm. Quarter-wave at H_max: c/(4·H_max) = 2.998e8 / (4 · 8.537e6) = 8.779 Hz. H(r) profile sampled at N=10000 trapezoidal panels over r ∈ [0, 20015 km]: H(0)=8537.0 km, H(20015e3)=837.1 km. Linear-radial <H> = (1/R)∫H(r)dr = 3315.8 km → 22.60 Hz. Area-weighted <H> = ∫H(r)·2πr dr / ∫2πr dr = 2134.8 km → 35.11 Hz. All independently computed; no scipy dependency.
quantitative_verification.notes: One sub-significant-figure tightening worth flagging (not a discrepancy, a precision note): δ_Cu(160 GHz) is 0.163 μm, not 0.2 μm. Our text rounds to one sig fig (~0.2 μm), which is fine. But a dome defender citing 0.163 vs 0.2 as if it mattered would be wrong on both counts — copper is opaque at both 0.16 μm AND 0.2 μm skin depth; the order-of-magnitude argument does not depend on the second sig fig. Could optionally tighten the text to "~0.16 μm" for sub-significant-figure precision, but not required.
